sources.note: LibreChat v0.8.8 source revision. The target is LibreChat itself, not a historical ChatGPT build.
enterToSend defaults to true. Custom shortcut overrides and during-run behavior are additional source features.
Source composer submission, composition guards and during-run modifier handling.
Right-aligned user bubble and plain assistant body; desktop content column uses responsive max-width classes.
Dark-theme color projection; six Loom tokens cannot preserve every source component surface.
Expanded sidebar minimum is 360 pixels. UnifiedSidebar uses this width when no saved width exists.
Source distinguishes saving an edit from rerunning a turn; this profile exposes only the Loom edit equivalent.

gaps: This maps selected LibreChat 0.8.8 source behavior; it does not reproduce ChatGPT or any other vendor application's version.

No pixel comparison was run against a deployed LibreChat instance. Fonts, icons, typed message blocks, parallel responses, responsive breakpoints, sidebar resizing and collapsed/mobile navigation remain partial.
The source has more theme surfaces than the six profile tokens. The 896-pixel desktop column is a fixed projection of the source's responsive XL column, not its complete layout.
Custom shortcut overrides, Ctrl/Meta+Shift+Enter, during-run steering, queueing, interrupt-and-send and answer-mode composer routing are not reproduced.
Loom edits preserve prior versions. LibreChat save-only, update-and-rerun, answer rerun and complete branch navigation are distinct operations not reproduced by message.edit alone.

Agents, MCP, Skills, attachments, artifacts, provider-specific request assembly, service memory, resumable streams and multi-user authorization need additional adapters; the selected Loom provider and context remain independent.
conversation-review and Inspect Loom knowledge are explicit Loom additions, not claims about LibreChat's native workflow.
